rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: WEKsunspat
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, before 1999).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2002 as 'Marilyn Monroe'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot or apricot blend. Mild, citrus, tea fragrance. 23 to 30 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, globular, high-centered to cupped bloom form. Prolific, continuous (perpetual) bloom throughout the season. Pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium, armed with thorns / prickles, spreading, upright, well-branched. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 4¼' to 6'7" (130 to 200cm). Width: 35" to 43" (90 to 110cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Vigorous. heat tolerant. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
